programmes.name: General Arts
programmes.overview: The General Arts programme equips students with a deep understanding of human society, culture, governance, and communication. It is ideal for students interested in law, journalism, public service, international relations, education, and the social sciences.
programmes.whoItsFor: Students interested in law, journalism, public service, international relations, education, and the social sciences.

programmes.name: General Science
programmes.overview: General Science is one of ANSECO's most competitive programmes. It prepares students for careers in medicine, engineering, pharmacy, computing, and the natural sciences through a rigorous curriculum in the physical and biological sciences.
programmes.whoItsFor: Students interested in medicine, engineering, pharmacy, computing, and the natural sciences.

programmes.name: Business
programmes.overview: The Business programme develops financially literate, entrepreneurially minded students. It provides the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in commerce, banking, accounting, and business management in Ghana's growing economy.
programmes.whoItsFor: Students interested in commerce, banking, accounting, and business management.

programmes.name: Agricultural Science
programmes.overview: Agricultural Science trains students in modern farming practices, food systems, and agribusiness. With Ghana's agricultural sector still a major pillar of the economy, this programme opens doors to food science, veterinary medicine, and rural development.
programmes.whoItsFor: Students interested in modern farming, food systems, agribusiness, food science, veterinary medicine, and rural development.

programmes.name: Home Economics
programmes.overview: Home Economics prepares students for careers in nutrition, hospitality, fashion design, and community health. The programme combines theory and hands-on practice in food science, clothing construction, and household resource management.
programmes.whoItsFor: Students interested in nutrition, hospitality, fashion design, community health, food science, clothing construction, and household resource management.

programmes.name: Visual Arts
programmes.overview: Visual Arts celebrates creativity and trains students in a wide range of artistic disciplines. It is perfect for students with a passion for design, architecture, film, fashion, and the creative economy — one of the fastest growing sectors in Ghana.
programmes.whoItsFor: Students interested in design, architecture, film, fashion, and the creative economy.
